newsitem.title: USA: Psychiatric Group hurt by Fla. hospitals.
newsitem.headline: Psychiatric Group hurt by Fla. hospitals.

text.p: American Health Properties Inc said poor financial circumstances at two Florida psychiatric hospitals could hurt funds from operations and dividends at its Psychiatric Group.
It would also likely force the company to lower its dividend next quarter, American Health said.
Psychiatric Group respresents American Health Properties' $52 million investment in five psychiatric hospitals.

The company said "significantly deteriorated financial circumstances" at Florida hospitals The Retreat and Northpointe Behavioral Health System had forced Psychiatric Group to record an impairment loss in the first quarter, reducing the carrying value of these assets by $11 million.
The final resolution of the financial situation at these facilities could significantly reduce or eliminate rental income, which could hurt Psychiatric's FFO and dividend levels.
Mostly as a result of the impairment charge, Psychiatric had a net loss for the first quarter of $4.52 per share compared to net income of $0.78 per share in the fourth quarter 1996.
American Health said it was still committed to optimizing the value of these investments over time.
